description: This file defines the InterfaceEngine class, which implements the GenericEngine interface. It provides methods for running services synchronously and asynchronously, but these methods throw exceptions indicating that interface services cannot be invoked directly. It also contains methods for sending callbacks, which are empty implementations.

classes.name: InterfaceEngine
classes.description: Implements the GenericEngine interface and provides service invocation methods that primarily throw exceptions for interface services, along with callback methods.

methods.name: InterfaceEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the InterfaceEngine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Attempt to synchronously execute a service; throws exception indicating interface services cannot be invoked directly.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Attempt to synchronously execute a service with ignore; throws exception indicating interface services cannot be invoked directly.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Attempt to run a service asynchronously with a requester; throws exception indicating interface services cannot be invoked directly.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Attempt to run a service asynchronously without a requester; throws exception indicating interface services cannot be invoked directly.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Empty implementation for sending callbacks with model service, context, and mode.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Empty implementation for sending callbacks with model service, context, result, and mode.

methods.name: sendCallbacks
methods.description: Empty implementation for sending callbacks with model service, context, throwable, and mode.
